open_points.subject: start_run
open_points.text: - start_run: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST check in this order and create no run on the first failure: the flow and its active version through active_flow_version, UnknownReferenceError propagating for an unknown flow and RefusedError when no version is active; RefusedError unless the inputs name exactly the active version's flow input ports, each once; each input in port name order through fit_port_value with its port, the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant and a JsonCandidate of its canonical bytes, RefusedError naming the port and the failed check; RefusedError naming the first function node, in node_id order, whose contract version has no current_activation.
open_points.other_text: - FilePayload fields (exact, no others exist): payload_kind: Literal['file'], port: str, content: bytes
open_points.question: Must start_run exclude file payloads, or must file inputs be validated with FileCandidate and the file-size ceiling instead of requiring JsonCandidate and canonical JSON bytes for every input?

open_points.subject: start_run
open_points.text: - start_run: [BEHAVIOR] MUST pin, in node_id order, one PinnedImplementation per function node with the implementation of that current activation, publish each input's canonical bytes with put_value_bytes, and write one StartRunChange through record_change with the given actor, with the active flow_version_id, the pins, one StoredValuesRef per flow input port in port name order and their StoredValues of value carriage with the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items), size and class; value_id and value_digest come from content_identity. Then MUST advance the run with advance_run and return its answer; a StopRequiredError from advancing propagates.
open_points.other_text: - Carriage enum values: 'value', 'file'; Python member names were not available in models context.
open_points.question: Must flow input ports be restricted to value carriage, or must start_run preserve file carriage and create file references rather than a StoredValuesRef and value-carriage StoredValue for every input port?

open_points.subject: derive_run_answer
open_points.text: - derive_run_answer: [FIELD_PROJECTION] Outputs are in flow output port name order: a ProducedOutput with the value_id for every produced output; for a run that has ended, a MissingOutput for every other output with reason skipped_by_guard when every edge into it was disabled by its guard or comes from a node recorded skipped_by_guard and not_produced otherwise (= models.OutputReason); a run that has not ended lists only produced outputs.
open_points.other_text: - advance_run: [SCHEMA_CONSTRAINT] A value port's PortRef names exactly one StoredValue; a mapped node's value output, once every element succeeded, is one StoredValue holding the canonical JSON array of the elements' values in element order, whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's value_schema as items, of the highest class among the elements, an empty list taking the highest class among the node's inputs, the mapped list and every other input, published with put_value_bytes and written by runs when the list is first delivered, never in an element's own change; when its canonical bytes exceed the imported RELEASE_CEILING_STORED_VALUE_BYTES_MAX constant nothing is written and the node is failed for its dependants, which conclude upstream_failed, every element record staying as it is; only a list that is delivered, to a node or a flow output, is measured, and an output no edge takes fails nothing; every delivered list of a mapped node MUST be measured before any of them is delivered or written, and when one exceeds the ceiling none of them is delivered, to a node or a flow output; a mapped node's file output is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, derived from the elements' NodeExecutions whenever it is delivered, after a restart too, since no record of its own holds it, whose disclosure_class is the highest class among the elements, an empty list taking the highest class among the node's inputs, the mapped list and every other input; a mapped element receives the list element at its map_index as its own StoredValue of the map_over port's value_schema and the list's class, or the spooled file at that position.
open_points.question: Must produced flow outputs be limited to StoredValuesRef values, or must RunAnswer provide a representation for a produced SpooledFilesRef instead of requiring a value_id for every produced output?

open_points.subject: advance_run mapped empty-list execution
open_points.text: a mapped node's file output is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, derived from the elements' NodeExecutions whenever it is delivered, after a restart too, since no record of its own holds it
open_points.other_text: - advance_run: [BEHAVIOR] A mapped node over an empty list executes and sends nothing and writes one NodeExecution succeeded without map_index, executed naming its pinned implementation or binding, every output an empty list; a mapped node concludes only when every element concluded, succeeded only when all succeeded.
open_points.question: For an empty mapped node, must its NodeExecution hold the empty file-output reference, or must the empty SpooledFilesRef remain derived and absent from the node's own record?
